objective: Implement complete role-free, tmux-only, low-intervention v2 parity with Rust as the sole semantic truth owner and canonical AppSDK compile/freeze governance.
acceptance_criteria: Equal peers own their complete task/resource lifecycle
Rust owns identity, task, resource, wait, message, subscription, wake ledger, journal, replay, and migration truth
tmux is the only live notification channel and sends only COLLAB_NOTIFY plus message id
AppSDK verify, compile, freeze, installed blackbox, and AGY Review pass on one exact candidate
non_goals: Do not import v1 runtime truth into v2
Do not expose v2 to zterm, OneStop, RouteCodex, or dsh-plugins before production admission
assumptions: Original Cordis Node package remains the plugin lifecycle owner
Codis remains the process/container lifecycle owner
Current verified v1 daemons remain untouched
